name: Friendships
description: Build relationships with six townsfolk over time. Talk to a befriendable NPC once a real-world day to raise your bond from STRANGER to BEST PAL; their greetings warm up and they gift you an item each time you reach a new level. A FRIENDS entry in the START menu tracks every bond. Persists with the save. Gym-leader friendships are a planned follow-up. No engine files touched, no maps edited.
